query.commandtext: SELECT DISTINCT PRODUCT FROM TQP_LOT_SUM WHERE END_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TESTAREA='MULTIPROBE'
SELECT * FROM TQP_LOT_SUM WHERE LOT_ID = :lot_id AND TESTAREA = :testarea

SELECT MIN(START_TIME) START_TIME, MAX(END_TIME) END_TIME, PRODUCT, ROUND(AVG(YIELD), 2) YIELD, SUM(WAFERS) WAFERS FROM TQP_LOT_SUM WHERE END_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TESTAREA='MULTIPROBE' GROUP BY PRODUCT

SELECT MIN(START_TIME) START_TIME, MAX(END_TIME) END_TIEM, LOT_ID, ROUND(AVG(YIELD), 2) YIELD, SUM(WAFERS) WAFERS FROM TQP_LOT_SUM WHERE END_TIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(:sTime,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(:eTime,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TESTAREA='MULTIPROBE' AND PRODUCT=:product GROUP BY LOT_ID
SELECT LOT_SEQ FROM TQP_LOT_SUM WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq
UPDATE TQP_LOT_SUM SET LOSS_DIE = (SELECT SUM(LOSS_DIE) LOSS_DIE FROM TQP_WAFER WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq AND PROBE_CNT = 0) WHERE LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq
SELECT PRODUCT, SUM(TESTED_DIE) AS TESTDIE, SUM(GEC) AS PASSDIE, ROUND(AVG(YIELD), 5) AS YIELD FROM TQP_LOT_SUM WHERE PRODUCT in (??) GROUP BY PRODUCT
SELECT * FROM TQP_LOT_SUM WHERE 1=1 AND LOT_SEQ = :lot_seq
SELECT * FROM TQP_LOT_SUM WHERE LOT_ID = :lot_id AND TESTAREA NOT LIKE '%FINAL%' AND TESTAREA LIKE '%MERGE%' ORDER BY LOT_SEQ DESC
SELECT * FROM TQP_LOT_SUM WHERE LOT_ID = :lot_id AND TESTAREA LIKE '%MERGE%' ORDER BY LOT_SEQ DESC
